title: Scorecard-wide feedback alignment returns all score metrics

comments.author: derek
comments.text:
Feature: Scorecard-wide Feedback Alignment
  Scenario: Get alignment for all scores in one call
    Given a scorecard "Moore Holdings - Cancellations AI" with 26 scores
    When I call plexus.feedback.alignment with scorecard only and all_scores=true
    Then I receive an array of score alignment metrics in a single response
    And each score metric includes name, accuracy, AC1, total_items, confusion_matrix
    And the response completes in under 5 seconds
    And I can optionally filter by accuracy_threshold to get only low-performing scores
